title: Staatliches Bauhaus

measurements.how_measured: visual inspection of stroke weight versus counters, absence of serifs, glyph width, and gaps between letters across all four rows
measurements.statement: typeface construction for all visible text
measurements.value: extra-bold, slightly narrow, low stroke-contrast sans with very tight letterspacing and near-touching glyphs

measurements.how_measured: compared outermost glyph extents to book-cover edges on left, right, top and bottom
measurements.statement: proportion of frame filled by type block
measurements.value: about 95% of width and about 90% of height filled, margins under 5% on all sides

measurements.how_measured: counted horizontal text bands reading top to bottom and compared their heights
measurements.statement: number and arrangement of text rows
measurements.value: exactly 4 horizontal rows of equal height stacked with almost no leading

measurements.how_measured: compared cap-height and numeral height of top row STAATLICHES to bottom row 1919-1923
measurements.statement: largest text height to smallest text height

measurements.how_measured: counted distinct ink hues and observed where color switches mid-word in each of the 4 rows
measurements.statement: number of text ink hues on dark ground
measurements.value: exactly 2 text hues - saturated orange and pale off-white - on dark brown, each about half the ink in alternating blocks within each row

measurements.how_measured: checked leftmost and rightmost glyph edges against cover edges and checked spacing between words
measurements.value: all rows justified flush to both left and right edges hugging the edges; no inter-word gaps, words run together

hypotheses.statement: Hierarchy works by color-block alternation rather than size, creating a rhythmic checkerboard tension across and down the lines.
Edge-to-edge justified density with heavy weight creates a monumental poster impact where type itself is the image.
Uniform size, weight and tight spacing across four equal bands gives a systematic, impersonal modernist order and loudness.

relations.rule: Set all text lines to identical cap-height at 1:1 and encode hierarchy only by switching ink color mid-line, never by size.
relations.target: all text lines in new layout

relations.rule: Justify every line flush to both left and right frame edges with under 5% margin and eliminate word spaces.
Use exactly two high-contrast text inks on a dark ground in roughly equal coverage, alternating in blocks within each line.

fragile_if_changed: Introducing margins, shrinking the type, or varying size for hierarchy would destroy the monumental edge-to-edge alternating-color block character.

skin_measured.how_measured: k-means (6 clusters) on the sent pixels for bg/fg; accent = median of strongly saturated mid-lightness pixels (s>0.45, 0.2<l<0.8) inside region 'two-hue alternating inks'
